I have started the test suite execution and am waiting for the results.
I have resolved the proxy authentication bug by updating [`prepend_scheme_if_needed`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-35e8v2ix/requests/utils.py#L960-L985) in [requests/utils.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-35e8v2ix/requests/utils.py).

### Root Cause
In `requests` 2.27.0, [`prepend_scheme_if_needed`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-35e8v2ix/requests/utils.py#L960-L985) switched from `urllib.parse.urlparse` to `urllib3.util.parse_url`. Unlike `urlparse`, `urllib3.util.Url.netloc` only includes `host` and `port` and excludes the `auth` component (`user:password`). When [`HTTPAdapter.get_connection`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-35e8v2ix/requests/adapters.py#L293-L318) normalized the proxy URL via [`prepend_scheme_if_needed`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-35e8v2ix/requests/utils.py#L960-L985), the proxy credentials were stripped before [`HTTPAdapter.proxy_headers`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-35e8v2ix/requests/adapters.py#L373-L393) extracted them, omitting the `Proxy-Authorization` header and resulting in a `407 Proxy Authentication Required` response.

### Fix
- Reconstructed `netloc` with `auth` (`'@'.join([auth, netloc])`) when `auth` is present in [`prepend_scheme_if_needed`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-35e8v2ix/requests/utils.py#L960-L985).
